answer: Prenatal hair follicles begin forming at 14-15 PCW, when budding of basal cells (hair placode and germ cells) and elongation of hair follicles (hair pegs) were observed; HF cells were identified in scRNA-seq data from 14 PCW.
support_quote: At 14-15 PCW, budding of basal cells (hair placode and germ cells) and elongation of HFs (hair pegs) were observed (Fig. 2a).
